changelog:
- Added support and instructions for searching and retrieving standalone audio recordings (not just video soundtracks), using new `search_recording` and `query_recording` commands.
- Updated guidance to include audio recordings and recordings-related queries wherever appropriate.
- Clarified the distinction between recordings and video audio transcripts throughout the usage and retrieval instructions.
- Adjusted media handling examples and scenarios to cover standalone audio recordings alongside videos and images.
- Expanded the "when to use" and "choosing the right type" sections to list questions about audio recordings and how to handle them.
